root_cause: The recommendation selector scored generic LinkedIn affinity without first enforcing channel identity. A verified personal recommendation could therefore outrank business recommendations for linkedin_company, while AI rewriting of a verified personal source could remove the concrete first-person event required by the final truth gate.
prevention_rule: Recommendation eligibility is channel-specific before scoring. linkedin_company rejects personal targets and personal-truth evidence, creates a canonical measurable campaign link, and requires company-page semantics. linkedin_personal final copy is rejected unless the text itself preserves first-person concrete source anchors and contains no business bridge.

evidence.incident_company: 2026-09-20 company artifact reused printer/personal content and failed doorklik gate
evidence.incident_personal: 2026-09-20 personal rewrite lost a concrete first-person event and failed FINAL_TEXT_CONCRETE_PERSONAL_EVENT_REQUIRED

outcome.truth_boundary: semantic isolation control is production-proven; downstream publish gates may still block individual channels
